body: Related SYNC async-question follow-up #2436 (#2433), independent Opus review r1 at 8a57126c4b01dcffedca6492abc1bf841283ae69: two LOW observations remain for later work. (1) If the event loop delivers another text key before an already-due question timer event, the held Enter conservatively becomes a newline rather than dispatching first; no wrong-question delivery occurs. Resolving it ahead of that later key needs a deliberate ordering design. (2) prepare_burst_enter_key consumes its timer token before checking due state; the timer deadline is currently computed after the composer deadline, making an early callback unreachable, but a future clock/refactor should rearm rather than strand a still-held Enter. These are source-review findings, not claimed live reproductions. The current delta also cancels question holds across app-level overlays/disconnects and global non-paste shortcuts; main-composer/AltGr follow-ups here remain separate.
